name: smartware-procedure-replay-run-config-v1
description: Run configuration for the three-arm procedure-replay benchmark. Pre-registered: it describes how the run is made, and no threshold lives here. Thresholds stay in contract-v1.json, which must not change.

model.policy: One model id, temperature 0, one fixed seed and one per-run budget cap for A, B and C. No model change inside a run. Changing the model means re-running the benchmark, never editing recorded results.
model.recorded_at_run_time: The provider model string returned by the endpoint is recorded in the results env block, not asserted here.

arms.B: Smartware procedure record plus its verification receipt, retrieved per run through the Smartware lane scoped to one client
arms.C: full procedure manual in the prompt

lane.implementation: src layer1 store plus layer3 search from the built package

notes: endpoint_env names the environment variables the run needs. No secret value is stored in this file or in any result file.
Token counts are measured per run and recorded in the results file. No arm JSON declares a token number.
